en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a two‑storey late‑19th/early‑20th‑century building with a gabled roof and decorative wooden details, set behind a grassy foreground with a few young trees. In front of the building stand several people and a horse‑drawn cart. The image is framed by a light vignette. Printed red text appears at the bottom center and along the left margin.
